comment: the-internet's Forgot Password: a one-field form whose submit should confirm that an e-mail was sent. The public demo answers with 'Internal Server Error' instead (its mailer is not configured), deterministically: a real defect of the demo, declared as the bug outcome and kept as an expected-red spec with `expect`, so a suite reads it `expected` and goes red only when the page starts behaving differently. Exercises a bug outcome whose evidence line is the server's own error text.
goal: Type the given e-mail address into the E-mail field and click 'Retrieve password', so that the page confirms 'Your e-mail's been sent!'.

email_sent.when: The page says 'Your e-mail's been sent!'

server_error.when: An error page is shown, such as 'Internal Server Error' or 'Application error'

still_on_form.when: After 'Retrieve password' was clicked the Forgot Password form is still shown with no message
